This is an issue very close to my heart so I feel compelled to include link for registries whenever I see posts like this. My father was a transplant recipient (lung) and most people do not understand the difficulties in getting a match. It is out there somewhere it is just a matter of finding it but simply not enough people register to be searched. Particularly in the case of stem cell, blood or bone marrow the process is very simple, essentially painless and offers you the potential to change the lives of the donor and their family and friends.

Signing your organ donation card on your driver's licence is even easier, so please do that as well.

Registering as a potential donor does not take much time and does NOT obligate you to donate if the opportunity arises. So... why not? Thanks for putting up with this rant.
